method.baseline: Full current App.jsx Q3_OVERLAYS -> buildDdiPeriodProducts, backlog ready, latest Children Navigator and 34 approved facts retained.
method.scope: ONLY the eleven literal user-selected id/name/unit/type identities. Historical October30 raw1 data corroborates their values but does not widen the scope. Set their existing applicable satellite metric to its existing maximum on cloned runtime results. OSAGO and every unselected team stay unchanged. No Navigator or other dependent recalculation.
method.teamScore: Existing completeProductPercent. Any missing applicable index answer -> null; otherwise points/max*100 rounded to integer. Raw score included separately.
method.aggregate: Existing dashboard: mean of rounded team DDI among scored teams, then integer rounding. Separate meanOfRaw is supplementary. Coverage/paired-cohort movement is explicit.
method.ranking: Competition rank = 1 + number of teams with strictly higher ROUNDED DDI. Ordinal = score descending, then existing en collator with sensitivity base/numeric true. Separate universes: all76 B2C and60 products; unscored teams unranked.
method.maturity: Existing maturityLevelName on rounded DDI: <40 attention; 40–60 developing; 61–80 mature; >80 leader.
